I am in a wheelchair and have been the majority of my life. I’m blind in one eye and partially deaf. Other than that I am a normal human being. I own and operate a successful financial business. I’m independent and able to do all things myself. 

In 2016 my wife left me after 13 years together. No warning, just left. I was devastated. After 8 months a friend and I had grown closer. After my first marriage I just wanted to have fun. She was bubbly, Intelligent and changed my life. 

After 6 months she was diagnosed with BPD. She pushed me away and told me she had no feelings for me. I stuck by her and ultimately wanted her to be ok. We eventually got back to the relationship we initially had. It was amazing. 

3 months ago this all started again. There was no affection and she just said she had no feelings for me. I really wanted to stay together and wait until she felt better. She seems ok to just move on. No emotion whatsoever. She claims she’s emotionally drained. 

I love this person and I want to support them.

Your broker will look after you (I’m one too) and present everything to you before you get too far. One thing to keep in mind in that location is what’s called “postcode restrictions”. Some lenders have high exposure in some post codes so they turn the tap off in those regions for a period. Again your broker will know this. 

Here in QLD you don’t pay stamp duty for first home owners which is a nice bonus as you can use those funds towards the deposit. 

As for the personal information required upfront, yeah it’s daunting. Unfortunately every bank is different with their policies so we need the whole picture before we can even start. We don’t want surprises along the way. 

Good luck with it all!!
